title: Cardiology Associates of Mobile and Teklinks agree to pay $1,250,000 to settle class action over October 2024 data breach
date_note: HIPAA Journal's article of 26 November reports the settlement; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: HIPAA Journal reports that Cardiology Associates of Mobile and its IT vendor Teklinks agreed to pay $1,250,000 to settle a class action from an October 2024 data breach, which exposed information of 172,678 current and former patients. Class members may claim a 24-month credit monitoring membership and up to a maximum of $4,000 per class member. The opt-out deadline is November 30, 2026 and the claim deadline December 29, 2026.
plain: HIPAA Journal reports a $1,250,000 settlement over a 2024 data breach affecting 172,678 patients. The opt-out deadline is November 30, 2026.
exec: A health practice and its IT vendor settle a breach class action for $1,250,000, HIPAA Journal reports.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Class members face an opt-out deadline of November 30, 2026 and a claim deadline of December 29, 2026, per HIPAA Journal.
geo_basis: the court is in Mobile County, Alabama; the practice is named for Mobile
